reviewed_by: Codex review of the notebook AppImage packaging failure and selected operator journey
reason: The 3.0.17 AppImage build failed because linuxdeploy rewrote the bundled notebook Python and uv RPATHs after the runtime manifest hashed them. A real-ELF packaging regression checks the final paths and stable hashes. Three focused real-Core notebook browser cases exercise run and reload on the production UI, including desktop and mobile browser coverage for this journey.
exclusions: No frontend or native source changed, so their unit layers are omitted. No unrelated Python tests, Playwright catalog entries, release diagnostics, or full suite are selected. The release's existing artifact audit and single installed-DEB core smoke will validate the final installers after this fix is merged.
